test_union_basic: test pl.union vertically concatenates two DataFrames with matching columns into a single DataFrame
test_union_diagonal: test pl.union with how='diagonal' combines DataFrames with different columns filling missing values with None
test_union_horizontal: test pl.union with how='horizontal' aligns DataFrames by row index padding shorter ones with None
test_union_align_lazyframes: test pl.union with how='align' on LazyFrames joins by a common key column collecting into a DataFrame
test_union_expressions: test pl.union on expressions concatenates column values vertically within a DataFrame select
